pipelines.name: Concurrent Test

steps.name: Build Accel
steps.run: make

steps.name: Install Harbor
steps.run:
HARBOR_VERION=$(curl https://api.github.com/repos/goharbor/harbor/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')
wget https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/releases/download/${HARBOR_VERION}/harbor-offline-installer-${HARBOR_VERION}.tgz
tar xzvf harbor-offline-installer-${HARBOR_VERION}.tgz

cd harbor
sudo ./install.sh

sudo docker login -u admin -p Harbor12345 localhost

sudo docker push localhost/library/wordpress

pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Prepare
steps.run:
platform=${{ matrix.platform }}
echo "PLATFORM_PAIR=${platform//\//-}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Export digest
steps.run:
mkdir -p /tmp/digests
digest="${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
touch "/tmp/digests/${digest#sha256:}"

steps.name: Create manifest list and push
steps.run:
docker buildx imagetools create $(jq -cr '.tags | map("-t " + .) | join(" ")' <<< "$DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_JSON") \
  $(printf '${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}@sha256:%s ' *)

steps.name: Inspect image
steps.run: docker buildx imagetools inspect ${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}

with.short-description: A general service to support image acceleration based on kinds of accelerator like Nydus

steps.name: Test Image
steps.run:
docker run -v $PWD/misc/config/config.nydus.yaml:/etc/acceld-config.yaml -d --rm -p 2077:2077 ${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }} /etc/acceld-config.yaml
sleep 5
curl -f http://127.0.0.1:2077/api/v1/health

steps.name: Run Linter
steps.run:
make install-check-tools
make check

steps.name: Build Binary
steps.run: make -e GOARCH=${{ matrix.arch }}

steps.name: Pack Binary
Create Release
steps.run:
TAG=$GITHUB_REF_NAME
cat <<EOF > ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/release-note.txt
Acceleration Service ${TAG} Release

(TBD)
EOF
ASSET_ARGS=()
for F in ${OUTPUT_DIR}/* ; do
  ASSET_ARGS+=("$F")
done
gh release create -F ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/release-note.txt --draft --title $TAG $TAG "${ASSET_ARGS[@]}"
